$Comment: Wear the whole Christmas Set: the Christmas Hat, Coat, Gloves and Trousers from Elsie's stall.
GEAR_SET_TIER counts a set's bonus tier coming on as gear goes on, its amount the number of pieces
that tier takes, so Amount 4 is met the moment the set's four-piece tier
(GearSets/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Set.json) comes on. Logging in already dressed counts nothing: the
Earned once and kept. The set carries from one Christmas to the next, so this file has no Parent: the
yearly skeleton would ask for the same clothes every year. It carries no merry tag, so the Merrymaker
never waits on it. It pays nothing but its points. The criterion's TextKey words the step from this
pack's own lang file. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_christmas_set.
